desc: TAPCO AR-15 Cleaning Kit for 5.56/.223 Cal - The TAPCO AR-15 Cleaning Kit is compact and handy for your .223/5.56mm AR-15. Whether your on the range, in the field, or at your own gun bench, this kit will have you covered. Its the perfect kit for your range bag. Includes: 6.5in length Rigid Coated Rod with Swivel T Handle, Rod Extension, Muzzle Guard, Phosphor Bronze Bore Brush, Precision Barbed Point Jag, Black Steel Patch Holder, 1oz CLP Needle Oiler, Cotton Flannel Cleaning Patches, Double Ended Nylon Utility Brush
